translation_snapshot.source:
We require recent yeti muscle tissue from powerful specimens. You will help us, or you will not. Either way they will come to us.
If you do so we shall reward you with petty knowledge so that you may postpone your death.
translation_snapshot.target:
我们需要从强大的雪人个体身上取得新鲜的肌肉组织。你可以帮我们，也可以选择不帮；无论如何，它们都会到我们手上。
如果你帮了我们，我们会赏你一点微不足道的知识，好让你推迟死亡。

translation_snapshot.source: Steamguns use bursts of steam directly injected in the barrel to propel metal shots with great force.
translation_snapshot.target: 蒸汽枪将一股股蒸汽直接注入枪管，以巨大的力量推射金属弹丸。

translation_snapshot.source:
Steamsaws use steam pressure to rotate a serrated metal blade at high speed.
Those struck suffer severe lacerations and bleed for 10% of the damage done per turn for 5 turns (stacking).
They can be wielded in the main or off hand.
Vrmmmmm!
translation_snapshot.target:
蒸汽链锯利用蒸汽压力驱动锯齿状金属刀片高速旋转。
被蒸汽链锯击中的目标将会受到严重割伤，在5回合内每回合受到相当于10%所造成伤害的流血伤害，可以叠加。
能装备在主手或者副手。
滋滋滋！！！

translation_snapshot.source: On falling below 20% of your max life, releases a cloud of smoke, confusing nearby enemies and giving you stealth and a chance to avoid incoming damage for 5 turns.
translation_snapshot.target: 生命掉落至20%以下时，释放一阵烟雾，混乱附近的敌人，令你潜行并有一定几率免疫伤害，持续5回合。

translation_snapshot.source: Strikes can trigger a thunderclap that damages and repel foes.
translation_snapshot.target: 攻击有几率触发霹雳震爆，伤害并击退敌人。
